name: Roll of Fate
source: Participate in a mysterious show, taking place far from civilization. The visual novel Roll of Fate gives you the opportunity to make decisions that affect the lives of the other show participants. Don’t try to save everyone – there’s no guarantee you can even save yourself.
translation: 参加一场远离文明社会的神秘表演。视觉小说《命运之卷》让你有机会做出影响其他节目参与者生活的决定。不要试图拯救所有人——甚至不能保证你能拯救自己。
